guards.rationale: Enchantment.__init__ defaults amount to 1, so the sim's bare constructor is Glam 1. No AscensionHelper branch in Glitter.cs, so 1m is the pinned non-ascension value, and Glam's own port is a faithful EnchantPlayCount +Amount once per combat (enchantments.py:351-371 vs Glam.cs). Recorded because the amount is invisible at the sim's call site -- a fixer changing the default would silently change this relic.

Glam adds no CanEnchant/CanEnchantCardType override, so C# uses EnchantmentModel.CanEnchant's base clauses: not Status/Curse/Quest (`(uint)(type - 4) <= 2u`), the type check, no Unplayable card sitting in the Deck pile, and no existing enchantment. Enchantment.can_enchant (enchantments.py:120-129) has the same four with one narrowing: it refuses an unplayable card in ANY pile, where C# only refuses one in the Deck pile. Not a divergence at this site -- a reward option is not in any pile yet -- so it is recorded here rather than verdicted; if it matters anywhere it belongs to the enchantment kind's own records, which are not on this branch (audit/records/enchantment/** lives on the event+enchantment stream's branch). Executed (`py audit/tools/relic_probes_b06.py b06-misc`): given options [strike, dazed], Glitter Glams the Strike and leaves the Dazed (a Status) alone.
